answer: Each new agent must burn a unique saffron-dyed token whose serial is bound to a quartz stake locked for one epoch; forging identities requires acquiring and destroying real tokens, so mass sybil creation costs linearly more than honest entry. A comet-shaped reputation trail then records each stake, letting peers verify history and making recycled identities detectable, since attackers must repeatedly pay stake and token costs without recovering them.
